name: OCBC 90°N Card
highlights: S$1 = Up to 7 Miles on Agoda accommodations worldwide
S$1 = 2.1 Miles on Foreign Currency spend
Designed with an LED light feature, the 90°N MasterCard Card lights up whenever you make a contactless payment.
Earn up to 7 Miles (equivalent to 7% cash rebate) for every S$1 spent on Agoda
Earn 1.3 Miles (equivalent to 1.3% cash rebate) for every S$1 spent in SGD
Earn 2.1 Miles (equivalent to 2.1% cash rebate) for every S$1 spent in foreign currency
Earn unlimited miles that never expire
All online purchases on your OCBC 90°N Card come with e-Commerce Protection, which safeguards you against non-delivery or defective goods or if the seller fails to reimburse you.

extra.summary: The OCBC 90°N Card suits frequent travellers wanting flexibility. Miles don't expire and transfer to multiple airline/hotel partners, offering redemption choice. Earn rates are decent, especially on overseas spend. The renewal bonus offsets the annual fee, provided you pay it. Consider if you'll use the miles, as waiving the fee forfeits the bonus. The LED light is a novelty, but the e-commerce protection offers practical online shopping security.

minimum-income-requirements.Singaporean/PR Minimum Annual Income:
•At least S$30,000 for Singaporeans and Singapore PRs aged between 21 and 54
•At least S$15,000 for Singaporeans and Singapore PRs aged 55 and above

our_takes.our-take: The OCBC 90°N Card suits frequent travellers wanting flexibility. Miles don't expire and transfer to multiple airline/hotel partners, offering redemption choice. Earn rates are decent, especially on overseas spend. The renewal bonus offsets the annual fee, provided you pay it. Consider if you'll use the miles, as waiving the fee forfeits the bonus. The LED light is a novelty, but the e-commerce protection offers practical online shopping security. High interest and late fees warrant responsible usage.
our_takes.good-for:
Jet-setters who want to earn air miles on overseas spending and redeem them for flights and hotels.
Salaried professionals who enjoy online shopping, seeking e-commerce protection and rewards on every purchase.
Individuals who like to travel and want to convert rewards points into benefits with hotel and airline partners.
our_takes.things-to-note:
A S$196.20 annual fee applies after the first year; consider if the card's benefits outweigh this cost.
Late payment fees are S$100; set payment reminders to avoid this hefty charge impacting your finances.
A high 27.78% annual interest rate applies if you carry a balance, increasing debt quickly.
